notation.M(X): Physical-normalization MWT coefficient of the original field X or original nonlinear product X.
notation.U,V,Theta,Omega,Phi_hat: M(u), M(v), M(Tprime), M(omega), M(Phi-prime), all in the same window and at the same coefficient time.
notation.Tprime: T minus the fixed SID reference-temperature profile; Phi-prime uses the fixed hydrostatic reference geopotential.
notation.div_h: Spherical horizontal divergence, with 1/(a*cos(latitude))*d/dlongitude of the eastward component and 1/(a*cos(latitude))*d(component*cos(latitude))/dlatitude of the northward component.
notation.hat_product_rule: M(omega*Tprime), for example, is the transform of the original product, not M(omega)*M(Tprime).

global_support: Only actual supported pressure columns enter transforms; 13-layer reference and horizontal diagnostics are distinct from the three actual omega levels. Geometry/NaNs are retained. Energy derivatives are formed on the fixed geographical grid before moving-neighborhood sampling.
pressure_work_category_note: W_PG is a direct work term combining pressure transport and same-window conversion under the stated theoretical relations; assigning it only to transport or only to conversion would be inaccurate.
no_closure_or_donor_claim: Horizontal Gamma contributions do not replace complete 3D canonical transfer. No residual, heat source, dissipation, exact local closure or identified donor scale is created by these outputs.
boundary_normalization_relation: For each K/A/P, vertical_input_Wm2 = (35000/g)*vertical_input_Wkg. These are the same boundary diagnostic in two normalizations.

metrics.positive_sign_meaning: Nonnegative horizontal kinetic energy in the selected scale window.
metrics.negative_sign_meaning: Negative values would be inconsistent with this definition.
metrics.verified_equation_source: Definition of K^window immediately preceding Eq. (49); Eq. (49).
metrics.source_relationship: The published multiscale horizontal kinetic-energy definition.
metrics.do_not_add_or_overinterpret: Not a rate or flux. It excludes vertical kinetic energy. Its pointwise sum across windows is not required to equal instantaneous raw-field KE.

metrics.positive_sign_meaning: Nonnegative dry APE relative to the shared stable reference profile.
metrics.negative_sign_meaning: Negative values would be inconsistent with positive c and this definition.
metrics.verified_equation_source: Eqs. (56)–(57), the multiscale quadratic-form construction leading to Eq. (66).
metrics.source_relationship: The dry local APE quadratic form evaluated using physical-normalization MWT temperature coefficients.
metrics.do_not_add_or_overinterpret: Not CAPE, latent energy or a source term. Missing or nonpositive stability is not zero APE. Do not cite Eq. (60) as the APE definition; it is a correction term.

metrics.positive_sign_meaning: The window energy increases locally on the fixed geographical grid.
metrics.negative_sign_meaning: The window energy decreases locally on the fixed geographical grid.
metrics.formula_ascii: d(KE)/dt on the native 21600 s grid before moving-neighborhood sampling

metrics.do_not_add_or_overinterpret: Not the time derivative of moving-region total energy. Do not add it to RHS transport/conversion terms as another energy input; no complete budget is asserted.

metrics.short_name_en: Horizontal contribution to KE canonical transfer
metrics.diagnostic_form: horizontal portion of conservative canonical-transfer expression
metrics.positive_sign_meaning: Positive horizontal contribution to the canonical-transfer term of this scale window.
metrics.negative_sign_meaning: Negative horizontal contribution to that term.
metrics.verified_equation_source: Eq. (46), with the horizontal spherical terms of Eq. (54); Eq. (47) is its continuous bracket form.
metrics.source_relationship: Horizontal contribution only; production evaluates the conservative form with spherical metric terms.
metrics.do_not_add_or_overinterpret: Not complete three-dimensional canonical transfer, not a named donor-window transfer, and not independently required to satisfy the full zero-sum property. Together with transport_K_h it forms the retained conservative horizontal nonlinear term, not a closed KE budget.

metrics.short_name_en: Horizontal contribution to APE canonical transfer
metrics.diagnostic_form: horizontal portion of conservative canonical-transfer expression
metrics.positive_sign_meaning: Positive horizontal contribution to the canonical-transfer term of this scale window.
metrics.negative_sign_meaning: Negative horizontal contribution to that term.
metrics.verified_equation_source: Horizontal terms of Eqs. (62), (64) and (68).
metrics.source_relationship: Horizontal contribution only, with c dependent on pressure but not horizontal position.
metrics.do_not_add_or_overinterpret: Not complete APE canonical transfer or evidence of a particular source window. Do not subtract the vertical dc/dp correction or the thermal apparent-source term from this horizontal expression. No independent horizontal zero-sum condition is imposed.

metrics.diagnostic_form: direct horizontal pressure-gradient work; composite pressure term
metrics.positive_sign_meaning: The window horizontal pressure-gradient force does positive work on the window horizontal wind.
metrics.negative_sign_meaning: The window horizontal pressure-gradient force does negative work on the window horizontal wind.
metrics.verified_equation_source: Pressure-gradient term in Eq. (37); relation to the pressure flux and conversion in Eqs. (38)–(39), (49) and (52).
metrics.source_relationship: Direct work from the momentum equation. Under pressure-coordinate continuity and dry hydrostatic balance, W_PG = -div_3D(Q_P) + C_A_to_K.
metrics.do_not_add_or_overinterpret: Not pressure-flux divergence alone. Do not add C_A_to_K again to W_PG as an independent KE source. Do not add a pressure boundary input again without changing to a consistent pressure-flux-plus-conversion budget form. The theoretical identity is not assumed to hold exactly in finite-layer ERA5.

metrics.short_name_en: 500–850 hPa net vertical KE input (per unit horizontal area)
metrics.pressure_scope: 500–850 hPa layer, using its two boundaries
metrics.diagnostic_form: pressure-layer boundary flux difference, per unit horizontal area
metrics.positive_sign_meaning: The top-minus-bottom flux supplies positive net KE input to the 500–850 hPa layer.
metrics.negative_sign_meaning: The top-minus-bottom flux removes net KE from that layer.
metrics.verified_equation_source: Vertical transport in Eqs. (45), (49) and (51). Pressure-coordinate mass integration gives the boundary difference.
metrics.source_relationship: Derived integration of verified flux formulas; the exact 500–850 hPa diagnostic is this study's implementation, not a separately numbered equation in Liang (2016).
metrics.do_not_add_or_overinterpret: Equivalent normalization of vertical_input_K_Wkg; do not count both as independent terms. This is not a complete layer energy budget or a complete canonical-transfer estimate.
